title: Heard: a spatial timeline where distance shows time

text: Recorded. It is the next step of the joint timeline, not a different thing: the same one stream of you, the assistant, me and the minions, drawn on a time axis. Hour marks always, minute marks only around events, seconds placing an event inside its minute, long empty stretches collapsed to a break like 4:00 to 6:00, and it scrolls by itself as time passes. It gets built as its own small task as soon as the plain timeline lands, so the minion holding the dev bar is not handed a sixth change mid-flight.
